draft.title: Rational and irrational numbers
card: a number that can be written as a fraction of two integers, such as \(\frac{3}{4}\) or \(\frac{5}{1}\). Whole numbers, negative integers such as \(-6\) and fractions such as \(-\frac{2}{3}\) are all rational.
a number that cannot be written as a fraction of two integers. Examples are \(\pi\) and \(\sqrt{2}\).

The decimal of an irrational number never ends and never repeats in a pattern. The decimal of a rational number either ends or repeats, and any decimal that ends or repeats can be written as a fraction.

For a whole number, its square root is rational only when the number is a perfect square. \(\sqrt{49} = 7\), which is \(\frac{7}{1}\), so it is rational. 10 is not a perfect square, so \(\sqrt{10}\) is irrational.
draft.remember: If it can be a fraction of integers, it is rational. If its decimal never ends or repeats, it is irrational.

a.q: Only one of these numbers cannot be written as a fraction of two integers. Which one is it?
a.why: 7 is not a perfect square, so \(\sqrt{7}\) is irrational and its decimal never ends or repeats. \(\sqrt{81} = 9 = \frac{9}{1}\), \(0.25 = \frac{1}{4}\) and \(-6 = \frac{-6}{1}\) are all fractions of integers, so they are rational.
a.clue: Try to write each number as a fraction of two integers.

b.q: Zara calculates a number as 2.636363..., with 63 repeating forever. She says it is irrational because the decimal is so long. Which statement is correct?
opts: It is rational, as a repeating decimal is a fraction
It is irrational, because the decimal is very long
It is irrational, because it is not a whole number
It is rational, because it has only two repeating digits
b.why: A decimal that repeats in a pattern can be written as a fraction of two integers, so the number is rational. In fact \(2.636363\ldots = \frac{29}{11}\). Length does not matter, and neither does how many digits repeat: an irrational decimal does not repeat at all.
b.clue: Does the decimal repeat in a pattern or not?

b.best: It is rational, as a repeating decimal is a fraction
